card.title: Xbox Fault Finding Using I2C

claims.statement: Xbox One S/X and Series S/X southbridge error codes can be read over I2C with a Raspberry Pi Pico running PicoDurangoPOST firmware and the XboxPostcodeMonitor app (console plugged in, then powered on after connecting).
Look codes up in the Xbox POST error code database at errors.xboxresearch.com.

procedure: Solder the three I2C points to the Pico.
Run XboxPostcodeMonitor, pick COM port and model, Connect.
Power on and read codes; look them up.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
